item.title: AI model releases: 9–15 November 2026
item.description: Fable 5.2 lowers token rates, Gemini 4 Hydrogen reaches the API, and DeepSeek and Perplexity change how common workflows are billed. Token-price pairs give input and output per million tokens. Dollar prices are USD.
